headline: MDA Space Posts $30.9M Q3 Profit and Raises Guidance
summary: MDA Space reported a third-quarter profit of $30.9 million and raised its full-year revenue guidance to be between $1.9 billion and $1.95 billion.
why: Space technology and satellite manufacturing firms provide earnings updates that reflect demand in defense and commercial space sectors.

impacts.name: MDA Space Ltd.
impacts.why: Positive earnings and an upward revision in annual revenue guidance indicate strong business performance.
